# Reunion Global — LLM Context & Agent Guide

> Discover REUNION in Udupi, offering luxury beach and city villas, premium suites, a beachside café, candlelight dinners, and a beautiful beach venue for weddings, celebrations and private events.

## About Reunion Global

Reunion Global Private Ltd. was founded in 2020 with a mission to redefine coastal tourism. We manage premium beach villas, oceanfront cafés, boutique hotels, and city villas — curated for families, couples, and groups who gather in style.

Peak travel season along the Udupi coast is typically **October–March**. Monsoon months bring quieter stays and lush scenery.

- [Website](https://www.reunionglobal.in): Primary portal for luxury stays, dining, experiences and events in Udupi.
- [About Us](https://www.reunionglobal.in/about): Company overview, executive team led by Mrs. Kshama Kadamba, and hospitality story.
- [All Stays & Residences](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties): Complete listing of beach villas, city suites, and coastal stays.
- [Beach Villas](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/category/beach-villas): Coastal villa collection.
- [City Stays](https://www.reunionglobal.in/properties/category/city-stays): Urban villas and suites near Udupi city.
- [Contact](https://www.reunionglobal.in/contact): Enquiries for stays, dining and events.

## Key Locations & Destinations

All coastal properties are situated in Udupi district, Coastal Karnataka, India (Serene is in the Malnad region near Shivamogga):

- **Hoode / Padutonse**: Direct beachfront villas with private beach access.
- **Uchila / Bada**: Peaceful coastal retreats and luxury pool villas.
- **Kapu**: Heritage beach area near the historic Kapu Lighthouse.
- **Mattu Beach**: Serene beachfront stays and beachfront dining.
- **Malpe**: Popular beach destination near Malpe Sea Walk and St. Mary's Island.
- **Udupi City / Chitpady / Kunjibettu**: Central stays near Sri Krishna Matha and city landmarks.
- **Manipal**: University campus town and healthcare center.
- **Shivamogga / Malnad**: Nature stay at Reunion Serene.
